messages:
cass: quick thread for the Gossamer dark theme PR i opened. main goals: improve chart legibility on deep panels, make syntax tokens easier to scan, and add an OLED mode toggle. attaching screenshots in PR.

nina: saw the shots. nice direction. two immediate things: legend markers are too small at 320px, and the heatmap ramp reads backwards in the tooltip.

drew: small accessibility note: toggling to OLED (true-black) reduces contrast for faint separators. we should add 1px semi-opaque separators in OLED to keep structure.

omar: colorblind check: the proposed categorical set has a purple/blue pair that collapses in protanopia. suggest switching one to a warmer amber. also prefer named semantic tokens (accent-action, success-muted) instead of numeric suffixes.

jun: copy nit: in Account > Appearance, label should be "Theme: Light / Dark / OLED" not "Enable dark mode". clearer and shorter. add short help text: "OLED uses true-black for lower power on supported displays"

cass: good call on semantics. current token draft:
```css
:root {
  --bg-surface: #050508; /* gossamer-900 */
  --panel-elev: #0b0c0e;
  --text-primary: #e9eef6;
  --muted-1: #98a5ac;
  --accent-action: #7fb3ff;
  --accent-strong: #5b8cff;
}
```

nina: for code blocks can we use this mapping? keywords #caa8ff, strings #ffb36b, types #8fe3c6, functions #7fb3ff. separation feels better when strings are warmer.

drew: re charts: instead of a multi-hue heatmap use a single-hue sequential (amber -> deep-orange) for token frequency; makes outliers easier to read and maps well to colorblind sims.

omar: agree about single-hue for heatmaps. for categorical series i propose: #88d0bf, #b9a6e8, #ffb07a, #7fb3ff, #ffd36b. avoids green/red pairings.

jun: a11y details: header buttons at 13px still fail 4.5:1 on the new panel. bump to 14px semibold or increase color contrast to hit 4.5:1.

cass: will update PR: bump header fonts, switch heatmap to sequential amber, replace problematic category with amber, update syntax tokens to nina's suggestion, and add OLED separators. also adding a small motion-reduction rule for gradient animations.

design-bot: PR #842: image diff report generated. 5 new screenshots, 2 flagged for low-contrast -> https://ci.internal/reports/842

drew: one more: focus indicators on interactive chart points use a 2px ring now — propose increasing to 3px for keyboard users and use an opaque tint rather than pure white.

omar: lint suggestion: add a stylelint rule to forbid color literals in components, require semantic token references only. helps keep themes consistent.

jun: UX micro: when switching theme in settings, show a tiny live preview thumbnail so folks can see OLED vs dark quickly. tiny improvement but reduces confusion.

cass: great ideas. i'll make those changes and ping for another pass. thanks! :sparkles:

design-bot: PR #842 updated by cass (branch/gossamer-theme). CI: 3/4 checks passing, visual-diff pending fixes.
